title: Turn order shown clearly: seat numbers and a First token with its reason
problem: Players are confused by the turn order: the badge on each stall card repeats the buying position, and nothing shows who buys first and why (random on Day 1, then least cash, Priority, Nest Egg on Day 3) or that the order runs clockwise.
scope: The badge on each stall card shows its fixed seat number round the table, so the clockwise order from the first buyer can be read
A First token on today's first buyer with the reason (picked at random, least cash, tie nearest the token, Priority card, Nest Egg Day 3) and "then clockwise"
Day 1: the token spins round the seats and lands at random; later mornings it slides to the new first buyer; none with reduced motion
exclusions: Any rule change (the engine already decides the order)
The print kit beyond a trivial player-aid line

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes, with tests of the reason and the seat badge
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merge 8a04062: 85 files, 934 tests passed, 1 skipped; tests/first-buyer.test.ts (12): the reason on Day 1, least cash, a tie with the token, Priority, Nest Egg Day 3, Priority on Day 3; the badge is the seat in every phase and every online view. After the owner's review (no reason line; the bar waits for the token): verify on the merge c9071a0, 937 tests passed; tests/first-buyer.test.ts now 13.

GitHub CI run 148 (verify:full, started by hand on 8a04062): solo game; speed test OK at the first try (longest task 82 ms, p95 82, opening 121 ms, DOM 579; run 141 was 105 ms, DOM 582); online match 54 pricing frames with 0 leaks, rematch, abandoned match, quick match, four players, reconnect 5 of 5. On the helper's shared machine the speed test sat just over 200 ms for this build (203 to 227) and for the build before it once in two; CI is the deciding check. After the owner's review: the helper's npm run test:e2e on 6a7e72a PASS (speed test longest task 168 ms, leaks 0).

acceptance.text: Pictures and a clip at 390x844 and 360x640 with 4 and 6 stalls
acceptance.evidence: The helper's sheet (Day 1, least cash, tie, Priority, Nest Egg Day 3; 390x844 and 360x640; 4 and 6 stalls) and two clips (Day 1 spin, Day 2 slide), seen by me; no overflow measured.

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-15: "include a first player token as well, show that the token is randomised on the first day and is passed to players following the rules, players currently are confused with the turn orders now"; and on the buying row: "make it so that the number on the card is not the buying order ... make it so that its the turn order so players understand that they are second since they are clockwise to the player who buys first".

added: A First token on today's first buyer; on Day 1 it spins round the stalls and lands at random, later days it slides; the buying bar and "Your turn" wait until it lands; screen readers hear why that stall buys first
changed: The number on each stall card in the buying row is its seat round the table, not its place in the buying order

playerNotes: The buying row shows each stall's seat number and a FIRST token on whoever buys first: it spins on Day 1 and moves each morning
